text.p: Publisher NV Verenigd Bezit VNU said on Tuesday it would pay a 1996 interim dividend of 0.14 guilders per share in cash, compared with an interim payment of 0.12 guilders last year.
The company will pay an interim dividend of 1.40 guilders in cash on its preference shares.
VNU said the interim dividend would be payable on October 29, adding that the level of the interim payment was no indication of the expected final dividend.
Last year, the company paid a total dividend of 0.48 guilders per share on earnings per share of 1.44 guilders.
In August, VNU said it expected growth of profits per share for the whole year 1996 to at least match the 13 percent increase posted in the first half of the year.
